articles.title: Harbour Energy raises production guidance, launches further $150 mln buyback
articles.summary: Investing.com -- Harbour Energy upgraded its full-year production guidance and announced an additional $150 million share buyback. The company reported third-quarter production of 484 thousand barrels of oil equivalent per day, up 9% year-over-year.
